## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2024-10-04: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.4 to the S-1
- 2025-01-30: Executed TRA dated as of IPO close, 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefit to Pearl Energy Investments, NGP, management, and other Legacy Owners
- 2025-02-03: 8-K reports IPO close and attaches the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2

#### Substantive accrual phase

- 2025-12-31: TRA liability recognized at $1.537M following initial INR-Unit-to-Class-A exchanges
- 2026-03-31: TRA liability rises to $3.585M after additional exchanges; no payments under the contract through Q1 2026

## Explanation

Infinity Natural Resources executed its Tax Receivable Agreement at the January 30, 2025 Up-C IPO, committing to pay 85% of the cumulative net realized tax benefit from Section 754 basis step-ups (on exchanges of INR Holdings Units paired with Class B common stock for Class A common stock) plus imputed interest to the Legacy Owners (Pearl Energy Investments, NGP affiliates, management, and other co-investors). The estimated early-termination payment was approximately $134.3M at the IPO. The contract is in force at the May 2026 cutoff, with recognized TRA liability of $3.585M as of March 31, 2026 and no cash payments yet made under the contract. The February 2026 Antero acquisition and concurrent Series A Convertible Preferred Stock issuance to Quantum Capital Group and Carnelian Energy Capital Management materially altered the capital structure but did not amend the TRA or trigger the change-of-control definition. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
